metadata.subject: DeviceCMYK colours as [c, m, y, k] tuples and 'c m y k' strings (pdfnative 1.8.0)
metadata.keywords: print, cmyk, rich black, process colour

blocks.text: CMYK everywhere a colour is accepted

Every PdfColor field accepts a four-element form since pdfnative 1.8.0: a tuple of ink percentages [c, m, y, k] (0–100) or a string of four operands "c m y k" (0–1). Both are emitted as DeviceCMYK fill (k) and stroke (K) operators. This heading is process red [0, 100, 100, 0]; the paragraph below is a rich black.
Rich black [60, 40, 40, 100] prints deeper than pure K on coated stock; solid black [0, 0, 0, 100] is what body text should normally use, so registration stays forgiving.
Under a PDF/A claim whose OutputIntent is not CMYK, CMYK content raises PDFA_DEVICE_CMYK_CONTENT; under PDF/X-4 with a CMYK output profile it is exactly what the press expects (see 05-pdfx4.json).
